subject: Partner continuity and SLA alignment — Waypoint integration support runbook
messages:
From: Anika Shah <anika@waypoint.io>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Waypoint Labs Integrations <integrations@waypoint.io>
Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Waypoint production alerts — need continuity plan

Hi Jordan,

We saw three tokenization-timeouts impacting our production connector yesterday between 02:15-02:45 UTC. The net effect was aborted inference for ~4% of requests in our EU region during the window. We've collected request ids and a short log bundle attached.

Per the partner contract we have an operational SLA to maintain 99.5% success for inference traffic. Right now the incident is within the grace tier, but our engineering and SRE teams are asking for a formal continuity plan and an escalation path for partner-managed outages.

Could Redwood share: 
- a short runbook for partner-facing on-call steps,
- primary/secondary escalation contacts (names & pager), and
- confirmation of automated fallback routing we discussed (hosted->dedicated on failover).

We appreciate a quick turnaround on this — our quarterly executive review is next Wednesday and we want to present a mitigation plan.

Thanks,
Anika Shah
Director, Integrations
Waypoint Labs

Attachments: waypoint_logs_20260517.zip (log bundle)
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: Anika Shah <anika@waypoint.io>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com, sergio_alvarez@redwoodinference.com, camila_reyes@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 11:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Waypoint production alerts — need continuity plan

Hi Anika — thanks for the heads-up and for the logs. Sorry you hit that window. We're reviewing traces now.

Short answers up-front:
- We will provide a one-page partner runbook and an escalation flow by EOD Thursday (05/21).
- Primary triage: sergio_alvarez (Partner Ops) / Secondary: laura_bennett (Sr. TPM, Platform). Both will be reachable via the pager rota we operate with partners.
- Automated fallback: confirmed. We can route Waypoint traffic to the dedicated pool when we detect >=2 consecutive infra errors in a 5-minute window. We'll add a canary test and a manual override for your SREs.

Proposed immediate actions:
1) My team will triage the logs and identify whether this is kernel-level OOMs or a transient KV cache miss.
2) Sergio will propose a minimal SLA addendum (non-prod testing window + failover thresholds) for your review.
3) We'll draft the runbook and share as a Google folder with attachments: sla_matrix.xlsx (SLA thresholds / handoff), escalation_flow.pdf (contact matrix).

Can you confirm your on-call contact for us so we can seed the page and test the pager in our staging environment?

-Jordan
Jordan Blake
Partner Success Manager
Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 415-555-0198

- Failover trigger worked as designed: traffic routed to dedicated pool within 45s after the second consecutive infra error.
- Canary request validation failed initially due to a mismatch in tokenization model variant; Camila fixed routing rules and redeployed a 1% canary.
- End-to-end success rate during the 10-minute test window: 99.7% (above 99.5 SLA).

Deliverables attached: sla_matrix.xlsx (thresholds & credit table), escalation_flow.pdf (contact matrix + paging play).

Immediate follow-ups:
1) Jordan/Sergio to run a quarterly table-top with Waypoint ops to review the flow.
2) Camila to add a fallback for model-variant mismatch to the canary checks.
3) We will add a mutual test calendar entry and a short Doc with steps (drive link shared).

Anika — please confirm acceptance by 05/29 so we can close this workstream in the partner program. If you prefer a short signature page we can send a lightweight addendum via DocuSign.
